title: God's Saving Will in the New Testament (1)
author: Rev. Angus Stewart
summary: A study of the two Greek verbs for willing — thelō and boulomai — and how they appear throughout the New Testament to describe God's saving will. The author distinguishes God's will of decree (what He sovereignly decides) from His will of precept (what He commands), and traces the implications for assurance, prayer, and Christian living.
